caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular woven textile featuring a repeating floral and leaf pattern. The primary colors used are a deep red and a dark blue, with the red forming the design elements and the blue serving as the background. The textile is bordered on two adjacent sides with a long fringe, blending both red and blue threads. The central part of the textile contains four large, symmetrical floral motifs composed of multiple leaves and flowers, predominantly roses, arranged in a mirrored layout. Smaller floral shapes and cross motifs fill the spaces between the larger designs. Along the bottom and left side, there are horizontal bands decorated with alternating rows of stylized flowers, leaves, and geometric patterns. The bottom left corner of the textile is folded over, revealing the patterned backside and its reverse color orientation. The entire composition is framed by a plain beige background, making the textile's design and colors stand out.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
